description: A3 task 15a (#747; REQ-035, REQ-037, REQ-038): re-record the three retained definition records on the Round 7 tree after TASK-120 (adoption closure, part 1). No product, gallery or src/dev change. The records docs/definitions/clear-refinement-20261103/TASK-035.md, TASK-037.md and TASK-038.md are edited in place under their body header clear-refinement-20261103: every repo: source rehashed at this revision; the files Round 7 removed (src/ui/refinements/overview.tsx, ladder.tsx, timed-result-log.tsx, logging-overlay.tsx, movement.tsx, workout-card.tsx; src/dev/gallery-refinement-coaching.tsx and gallery-refinement-cards.tsx) re-pointed to the Round 7 code that holds or draws the same copy, since no ref:accepted-gallery or base: blob holds their bytes; claims tied to a moved source re-recorded against Round 7 (the timed formats drawn by TimedWorkoutFlow, the cards state on the gallery runtime, BlockPanel, the movement note under the product presentation). scripts/refinement/verify-definition-record.mjs and lib/references.mjs are unchanged. Only the named old-build assertions of rehearsal finding 6 change: task-038 (required sources, the coaching gallery page reads, the CoachingMovementSection shape, the cards page and WorkoutCard slot reads) and task-037 (the now paths and form of X2, X3, X4 and X6); each re-point is a row of evidence/refinement/task-121/test-ledger.json. check-01 runs the three record tests together through the guard; ref: sources resolve through the out-of-Git reference object store (<project>/evidence-store in the Runner layout, or CLEAR_REFINEMENT_EVIDENCE_DIR), which fails closed. TASK-035, TASK-037 and TASK-038 keep their own check-01 manifests, rerun here to refresh their receipts. Every declared case must execute and pass.
